33261.a:
```
kubectl --> [kube-apiserver] <--> [etcd]
               ^     ^
     [scheduler]     [controller-manager]
               |
   ------------+-------------
   [node: kubelet + containerd + kube-proxy] x N
```
- Hamma komponent faqat **apiserver** orqali gaplashadi, etcd'ga to'g'ridan faqat apiserver.
- Model: declarative — siz desired state yozasiz, controller'lar reconcile loop bilan real holatni unga yaqinlashtiradi.
- Managed (EKS/GKE/AKS) — control plane'ni provider boshqaradi.

33262.a:
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: { name: api, labels: { app: api } }
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
  template:
    metadata: { labels: { app: api } }
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        image: ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.0
        ports: [{ containerPort: 8080 }]
        resources:
          requests: { cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi }
          limits:   { memory: 256Mi }
        readinessProbe: { httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 } }
```
Gotcha: `selector` immutable — o'zgartirish uchun Deployment'ni qayta yaratish kerak.
Tekshirish: `kubectl apply --dry-run=server -f api.yaml`, `kubectl diff -f`.

33263.a:
```sh
kubectl set image deploy/api api=ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0
kubectl rollout status deploy/api --timeout=5m
kubectl rollout history deploy/api
kubectl rollout undo deploy/api                 # oldingi
kubectl rollout undo deploy/api --to-revision=3
kubectl rollout restart deploy/api              # pod'larni qayta yaratish (config o'zgarganda)
kubectl rollout pause/resume deploy/api
```
`revisionHistoryLimit` (default 10) — eski ReplicaSet'lar soni.
GitOps'da `undo` vaqtinchalik: Git'dagi holat qaytib yozadi — rollback Git revert orqali.

33264.a:
```sh
helm repo add bitnami https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami
helm install redis bitnami/redis -n cache --create-namespace -f values-prod.yaml
helm upgrade --install api ./charts/api -f values-prod.yaml --set image.tag=1.5.0
helm list -A
helm history api
helm rollback api 3
helm template ./charts/api -f values-prod.yaml   # render, cluster'siz
```
Chart tuzilmasi: `Chart.yaml`, `values.yaml`, `templates/` (Go template), `charts/` (dependency).
`upgrade --install --atomic --wait` — muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa avtomatik rollback.

33265.a:
```
base/       deployment.yaml service.yaml kustomization.yaml
overlays/
  prod/     kustomization.yaml  (replicas: 5, image tag, patch)
```
```yaml
# overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml
resources: [../../base]
namespace: prod
images: [{ name: ghcr.io/acme/api, newTag: "1.5.0" }]
replicas: [{ name: api, count: 5 }]
patches: [{ path: resources-patch.yaml }]
```
| | Helm | Kustomize |
|---|---|---|
| Usul | template | patch/overlay |
| Release/rollback | bor | yo'q (GitOps beradi) |
| O'qish | render qilish kerak | toza YAML |
Ko'p jamoa ikkalasini birga: Helm chart + Kustomize post-render.

33266.a:
```yaml
spec:
  initContainers:
  - name: wait-db
    image: busybox
    command: ["sh","-c","until nc -z postgres 5432; do sleep 2; done"]
  - name: log-agent              # native sidecar (1.29+)
    image: fluent-bit
    restartPolicy: Always
  containers:
  - name: api
    image: acme/api
```
Native sidecar afzalligi: asosiy container'dan **oldin** start, **keyin** to'xtaydi; Job tugashini bloklamaydi.
Gotcha: DB migration'ni init container'da qilish — har replika parallel migration qiladi; alohida Job yoki lock kerak.

33267.a:
```yaml
spec:
  replicas: 10
  minReadySeconds: 10
  progressDeadlineSeconds: 600
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate: { maxSurge: 25%, maxUnavailable: 0 }
```
- `maxUnavailable: 0` — sig'im kamaymaydi (ko'proq resurs kerak).
- Readiness probe'siz rolling update "ko'r" — ishga tushmagan pod'ga trafik ketadi.
- `progressDeadlineSeconds` o'tsa rollout `ProgressDeadlineExceeded` — CI shuni kutib fail qilishi kerak.
- `Recreate` — hammasini o'chirib keyin yangisi (downtime, lekin ikki versiya birga ishlamaydi).

33268.a:
```
delete pod -> [endpoint'dan chiqarish] ... kube-proxy/LB yangilanishi (soniyalar)
           -> preStop (sleep 5) -> SIGTERM -> ilova drain -> exit
           -> grace period (30s) tugasa SIGKILL
```
```yaml
spec:
  terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 40
  containers:
  - lifecycle:
      preStop: { exec: { command: ["sleep", "5"] } }   # yoki sleep action (1.30+)
```
Go: `signal.NotifyContext(ctx, syscall.SIGTERM)` + `srv.Shutdown(ctx)`.
Gotcha: shell form `CMD` — PID 1 `sh`, SIGTERM ilovaga yetmaydi -> exec form.

33269.a:
```yaml
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata: { name: api }
spec:
  minAvailable: 2          # yoki maxUnavailable: 1
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
```
- `kubectl drain` PDB'ni hurmat qiladi (eviction API).
- Gotcha: `replicas: 1` + `minAvailable: 1` — drain abadiy osiladi, upgrade bloklanadi.
- Deployment rolling update PDB'ga bo'ysunmaydi (o'z maxUnavailable'i bor).
- Quorum tizimlari (etcd, Kafka, ZK): `maxUnavailable: 1`.

33270.a:
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
spec:
  serviceName: db            # headless service nomi
  replicas: 3
  podManagementPolicy: OrderedReady
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - metadata: { name: data }
    spec: { accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce], resources: { requests: { storage: 50Gi } } }
```
- Pod qayta yaratilsa **o'sha** PVC'ga ulanadi.
- StatefulSet o'chirilganda PVC'lar qoladi (ma'lumot xavfsizligi) — `persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy` bilan boshqariladi.
- Replikatsiya, failover, backup'ni StatefulSet bermaydi — buni Operator (CloudNativePG, Strimzi) qiladi.

33271.a:
```yaml
# templates/deployment.yaml
metadata:
  name: {{ include "api.fullname" . }}
  labels: {{- include "api.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        checksum/config: {{ include (print $.Template.BasePath "/configmap.yaml") . | sha256sum }}
```
- `checksum/config` — ConfigMap o'zgarsa pod'lar avtomatik rollout.
- Hook: `"helm.sh/hook": pre-upgrade` + `hook-delete-policy`; hook fail bo'lsa release fail.
- `required` funksiyasi: `{{ required "image.tag kerak" .Values.image.tag }}`.
- CI: `helm lint`, `helm template | kubeconform -strict`, `helm unittest`.

33272.a:
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
spec:
  schedule: "0 3 * * *"
  timeZone: "Asia/Tashkent"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  startingDeadlineSeconds: 600
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 5
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 3
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 3600
      ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 86400
      template:
        spec: { restartPolicy: OnFailure, containers: [...] }
```
CronJob "at least once" — ba'zan ikki marta ishga tushishi mumkin, ba'zan o'tkazib yuboriladi: idempotentlik va monitoring (oxirgi muvaffaqiyatli vaqt metrikasi) kerak.

33273.a:
- **Oddiy canary:** `api-stable` 9 replika + `api-canary` 1 replika, bitta Service — ~10% (replika soniga bog'liq, aniq emas).
- **Gateway API weight:**
```yaml
rules:
- backendRefs:
  - { name: api-stable, port: 80, weight: 95 }
  - { name: api-canary, port: 80, weight: 5 }
```
- **Argo Rollouts:** steps (5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%), har qadamda Prometheus AnalysisTemplate (error rate < 1%), fail bo'lsa avtomatik abort.

Shartlar: backward-compatible DB migration (expand/contract), ikki versiya bir vaqtda ishlay olishi, canary metrikalari versiya label'i bilan ajratilgan.

33274.a:
```yaml
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata: { name: pg }
spec:
  instances: 3
  storage: { size: 100Gi }
  backup: { barmanObjectStore: { destinationPath: s3://acme-pg-backup } }
```
Operator reconcile loop: kuzat (watch) -> real holatni o'qi -> farqni hisobla -> harakat -> status yoz. Idempotent bo'lishi shart.

O'zingiz yozish (kubebuilder/controller-runtime) — faqat ichki platforma uchun takrorlanadigan murakkab operatsiya bo'lsa. Aks holda Helm + GitOps yetarli. Xavf: buggy operator butun cluster'ga zarar yetkazadi.

33275.a:
```
CI: test -> image build -> push -> config repo'da image tag PR
                                         |
Argo CD (cluster ichida) <--- poll/webhook
   -> diff -> sync -> health check
```
| | Push (CI kubectl apply) | GitOps (pull) |
|---|---|---|
| Cluster credential | CI'da | cluster ichida |
| Drift | aniqlanmaydi | aniqlanadi, self-heal |
| Audit | CI loglari | Git tarixi |

Amaliyot: app kod repo va config (environment) repo alohida; App-of-apps / ApplicationSet ko'p cluster uchun; secret'lar SOPS/Sealed Secrets/External Secrets bilan.

33276.a:
Tartib:
1. **Tayyorgarlik:** deprecated/removed API'lar — `kubent`, `pluto detect-helm`; manifest va Helm chart'larni yangilash.
2. Add-on'lar mosligi: CNI, CoreDNS, kube-proxy, ingress controller, cert-manager, CSI.
3. **Staging** cluster'da to'liq sinov.
4. Control plane: faqat +1 minor (skip yo'q). Control plane rollback qilib bo'lmaydi.
5. Node'lar: yangi node group yaratish -> `cordon` + `drain` (PDB) -> eski'larni o'chirish (blue-green node'lar).
6. Kuzatish: error rate, pending pod'lar, DNS.

Kubelet control plane'dan ko'pi bilan 3 minor orqada bo'lishi mumkin (1.28+). Upgrade'ni muntazam qiling — 4 versiya orqada qolish eng xavfli.

33277.a:
Scheduler **requests** ga qaraydi, haqiqiy foydalanishga emas.
```sh
kubectl describe pod api-xyz
# Events: 0/5 nodes are available: 3 Insufficient cpu,
#         2 node(s) had untolerated taint {dedicated: gpu}
```
Pending sabablari: requests juda katta, taint, affinity mos emas, PVC boshqa AZ'da, ResourceQuota.
Event matni — eng tez diagnostika.

33278.a:
```sh
kubectl taint nodes gpu-1 dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule
kubectl label nodes gpu-1 accelerator=nvidia
```
```yaml
spec:
  tolerations:
  - { key: dedicated, value: gpu, effect: NoSchedule }
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
        nodeSelectorTerms:
        - matchExpressions: [{ key: accelerator, operator: In, values: [nvidia] }]
```
GPU node'ni faqat GPU workload'ga ajratish uchun **ikkalasi** kerak: taint begonalarni haydaydi, affinity GPU pod'ni u yerga tortadi.
Effect'lar: `NoSchedule`, `PreferNoSchedule`, `NoExecute` (mavjud pod'larni ham chiqaradi).

33279.a:
```yaml
volumes:
- name: tmp
  emptyDir: { sizeLimit: 1Gi }      # medium: Memory -> tmpfs (RAM limitga kiradi)
- name: cfg
  configMap: { name: api-config }
- name: data
  persistentVolumeClaim: { claimName: api-data }
```
- hostPath — container node'ga chiqish yo'li; Pod Security `restricted` uni taqiqlaydi.
- configMap mount yangilanadi (~1 daqiqa), lekin `subPath` bilan mount qilingani **yangilanmaydi**; env orqali berilgani ham yangilanmaydi (restart kerak).

33280.a:
| Mode | Qisqa | Misol backend |
|---|---|---|
| ReadWriteOnce | RWO | EBS, PD, Azure Disk |
| ReadOnlyMany | ROX | NFS, oldindan to'ldirilgan disk |
| ReadWriteMany | RWX | EFS, NFS, CephFS |
| ReadWriteOncePod | RWOP | CSI drayverlar (1.29 GA) |

Gotcha: RWO = bitta **node**, bitta pod emas — shu node'dagi ikki pod ikkalasi yozishi mumkin.
EBS AZ'ga bog'langan: pod boshqa AZ'dagi node'ga tushsa volume ulanmaydi — StorageClass'da `volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer`.

33281.a:
```yaml
startupProbe:
  httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }
  failureThreshold: 30
  periodSeconds: 2          # 60s gacha start uchun
readinessProbe:
  httpGet: { path: /ready, port: 8080 }
  periodSeconds: 5
livenessProbe:
  httpGet: { path: /healthz, port: 8080 }
  periodSeconds: 10
  failureThreshold: 3
```
Anti-pattern: liveness ichida DB/Redis tekshirish — DB sekinlashsa **hamma** pod restart, kaskad incident. Liveness faqat jarayonning o'zi tirikligini tekshirsin; dependency holati — readiness'da (ehtiyotkorlik bilan).

33282.a:
```yaml
topologySpreadConstraints:
- maxSkew: 1
  topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
  whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
  labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
- maxSkew: 1
  topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
  whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
  labelSelector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }
```
- `DoNotSchedule` — qat'iy (pod Pending bo'lishi mumkin), `ScheduleAnyway` — afzallik.
- Required anti-affinity katta cluster'da scheduler'ni sekinlashtiradi va replica > node bo'lsa Pending — spread constraints afzalroq.
- Scale-down'da balans saqlanmaydi — descheduler.

33283.a:
```
yuk oshdi -> HPA replica 5->15 -> 10 pod Pending (joy yo'q)
          -> Karpenter mos instance tanlab node qo'shadi (~1 daqiqa)
yuk tushdi -> HPA kamaytiradi -> bo'sh node'lar konsolidatsiya qilinadi
```
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
spec:
  scaleTargetRef: { apiVersion: apps/v1, kind: Deployment, name: api }
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 30
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource: { name: cpu, target: { type: Utilization, averageUtilization: 70 } }
  behavior:
    scaleDown: { stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300 }
```
VPA odatda `updateMode: "Off"` — faqat tavsiya, requests'ni to'g'ri tanlash uchun.

33284.a:
```yaml
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
spec:
  scaleTargetRef: { name: order-consumer }
  minReplicaCount: 0
  maxReplicaCount: 24          # partition sonidan oshmasin
  triggers:
  - type: kafka
    metadata:
      bootstrapServers: kafka:9092
      consumerGroup: orders
      topic: orders
      lagThreshold: "500"
```
CPU consumer uchun yomon signal: IO kutayotgan consumer CPU past, lag esa o'sadi.
Kafka: consumer soni > partition soni — ortiqchalari bo'sh turadi.
Scale-to-zero: birinchi xabarga cold start kechikishi.

33285.a:
```yaml
apiVersion: storage.k8s.io/v1
kind: StorageClass
metadata: { name: gp3-retain }
provisioner: ebs.csi.aws.com
parameters: { type: gp3, encrypted: "true" }
reclaimPolicy: Retain
allowVolumeExpansion: true
volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer
```
- Muhim DB uchun `Retain` — tasodifiy `kubectl delete pvc` ma'lumotni o'chirmaydi.
- `allowVolumeExpansion` — PVC hajmini oshirish (kamaytirish mumkin emas).
- Backup: VolumeSnapshot (CSI) yoki Velero; ilova darajasidagi backup (pg_dump/WAL) baribir kerak.

33286.a:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ResourceQuota
metadata: { name: team-a, namespace: team-a }
spec:
  hard:
    requests.cpu: "20"
    requests.memory: 64Gi
    limits.memory: 96Gi
    pods: "100"
    services.loadbalancers: "2"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: LimitRange
spec:
  limits:
  - type: Container
    default:        { memory: 256Mi }
    defaultRequest: { cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi }
```
Gotcha: quota'da `requests.cpu` bo'lsa requests'siz pod **rad etiladi** — LimitRange default bilan birga ishlating.

33287.a:
Belgilar: `container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total / container_cpu_cfs_periods_total` yuqori, CPU usage < limit.

```yaml
resources:
  requests: { cpu: "500m", memory: 512Mi }
  limits:   { memory: 512Mi }            # CPU limit yo'q
env:
- name: GOMAXPROCS
  valueFrom: { resourceFieldRef: { resource: requests.cpu, divisor: "1" } }
```
Go 1.25+ GOMAXPROCS'ni cgroup limitiga avtomatik moslaydi (oldin `automaxprocs`).
Trade-off: limit'siz — noisy neighbor xavfi (requests bo'yicha adolatli ulush baribir kafolatlangan). Multi-tenant/to'lovli cluster'da limit kerak bo'lishi mumkin.
Memory limit esa **qo'yiladi**: memory siqib bo'lmaydi, oshsa OOMKill.

33288.a:
```sh
kubectl describe node ip-10-0-1-5
# Conditions: MemoryPressure True, DiskPressure False
kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase=Failed
# Reason: Evicted, Message: The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage
```
- Kernel OOM killer (cgroup limit) va kubelet eviction — **turli** mexanizmlar.
- Ephemeral storage: container log'lari va emptyDir ham hisoblanadi — `ephemeral-storage` requests/limits qo'ying.
- PriorityClass: muhim tizim pod'lari pastroq prioritetdagilarni preempt qiladi.
- `system-reserved`/`kube-reserved` — kubelet va OS uchun joy qoldirish, aks holda node NotReady.

33289.a:
Metrikalar:
- requests / allocatable (rezervatsiya) va usage / requests (samaradorlik). Odatiy holat: requests 70%, usage 25% — pul behuda.
- Kubecost/OpenCost — namespace/jamoa bo'yicha xarajat.

Usullar:
1. Right-sizing: VPA recommender yoki Goldilocks.
2. Karpenter `consolidationPolicy: WhenEmptyOrUnderutilized`, instance turlarini keng ruxsat.
3. **Overprovisioning:** past prioritetli "pause" pod'lar joy egallab turadi; haqiqiy pod kelsa ular preempt bo'ladi va darhol joy ochiladi.
4. Spot: stateless workload'lar, PDB va topology spread bilan; interruption handler.
5. Kichik node'lar — daemonset overhead ulushi katta; juda katta node — blast radius katta.

33290.a:
```sh
ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot save /backup/etcd-$(date +%F).db \
  --endpoints=https://127.0.0.1:2379 --cacert=ca.crt --cert=etcd.crt --key=etcd.key
etcdctl endpoint status --write-out=table
etcdctl defrag
```
- Disk: SSD, `wal_fsync_duration_seconds` p99 < 10ms; sekin disk = leader election'lar, API sekin.
- Hajm limiti (default 2GB, max ~8GB) — ko'p Event/CRD obyekt; defrag va compaction.
- Secret'lar: apiserver `EncryptionConfiguration` (KMS).
- Managed K8s'da etcd provider'da — lekin cluster obyektlarini Velero/GitOps bilan tiklash rejasi baribir kerak.

33291.a:
```sh
kubectl get pod api-xyz
kubectl describe pod api-xyz        # Last State: Terminated, Exit Code, Reason
kubectl logs api-xyz --previous     # yiqilgan container logi
kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp -n prod
```
| Exit code | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| 1 | ilova xatosi (config, DB ulanmadi) |
| 137 | SIGKILL — OOMKilled yoki liveness |
| 139 | segfault |
| 143 | SIGTERM |
| 127/126 | buyruq topilmadi / bajarib bo'lmaydi |

Tez-tez sabablar: noto'g'ri env/secret, DB mavjud emas, liveness juda agressiv, noto'g'ri `command`/entrypoint.

33292.a:
```sh
kubectl describe pod api-xyz
# Failed to pull image "acme/api:1.5": ... not found
# ... 401 Unauthorized
# ... toomanyrequests: You have reached your pull rate limit
```
Yechimlar:
```sh
kubectl create secret docker-registry regcred --docker-server=ghcr.io \
  --docker-username=bot --docker-password=$TOKEN -n prod
```
```yaml
spec: { imagePullSecrets: [{ name: regcred }] }
```
- Cloud'da: node IAM role (ECR), ServiceAccount'ga biriktirish.
- Docker Hub limiti: pull-through cache yoki o'z registry'ingiz.
- `exec format error` — image boshqa arxitektura uchun; multi-arch build (`buildx --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64`).

33293.a:
```sh
kubectl exec -it api-xyz -- sh
kubectl port-forward svc/api 8080:80          # localhost:8080 -> service
kubectl debug -it api-xyz --image=nicolaka/netshoot --target=api   # ephemeral container
kubectl debug node/ip-10-0-1-5 -it --image=ubuntu                  # node'ga
kubectl run tmp --rm -it --image=busybox -- nslookup api.prod.svc.cluster.local
```
Distroless/scratch image'da `exec sh` ishlamaydi — `debug --target` bilan bir xil process namespace'da tool'lar ishlatiladi.
Prod'da exec huquqi RBAC bilan cheklangan va audit qilinishi kerak.

```sh
kubectl get svc api -o wide
kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=api   # bo'sh = selector/readiness muammo
kubectl run t --rm -it --image=nicolaka/netshoot -- bash
```

`targetPort` container porti bilan, `port` — Service porti.

33304.a:
Tartib:
1. **Nima o'zgardi?** deploy/upgrade/config (`kubectl get events -A`, GitOps tarixi).
2. **Node'lar:** `kubectl get nodes`, `top nodes`, NotReady, pressure, CPU steal.
3. **DNS:** CoreDNS latency/xatolar — klassik "hamma narsa sekin" sababi (ndots:5 + tashqi domen -> 5 ta keraksiz so'rov). NodeLocal DNSCache.
4. **Tarmoq:** conntrack to'lishi (`nf_conntrack: table full`), CNI IP tugashi.
5. **Umumiy dependency:** DB connections, Redis latency.
6. **Throttling:** CPU limit throttling hamma pod'larda.
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(coredns_dns_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))
```
Containment: trafik kamaytirish/rate limit, oxirgi o'zgarishni rollback — root cause'ni keyin.

```sh
aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id prod/db --query SecretString --output text
```

33346.a:
```
app -> /etc/hosts -> lokal resolver (systemd-resolved) -> rekursiv resolver (8.8.8.8 / VPC DNS)
          -> root -> .com -> example.com authoritative -> A 93.184.216.34 (TTL 300)
```
```sh
dig example.com +short
dig example.com A +trace          # butun zanjir
dig @8.8.8.8 example.com          # aniq server'dan
dig -x 93.184.216.34              # reverse (PTR)
resolvectl status; cat /etc/resolv.conf
```
"DNS o'zgartirdim, ishlamayapti" — ko'pincha eski TTL hali cache'da. Migratsiyadan oldin TTL'ni pasaytiring.

Alert'lar odatda 5xx ulushi bo'yicha; 4xx o'sishi esa client yoki deploy (API o'zgarishi) belgisi bo'lishi mumkin.

33349.a:
```
10.0.11.5:43122 --> [NAT GW 3.120.5.9:61001] --> api.github.com:443
                <--  javob mapping orqali qaytadi
internet --> 3.120.5.9:61001 (mapping yo'q) --> rad etiladi
```
- Kiruvchi trafik uchun: load balancer, port forwarding (DNAT) yoki public IP.
- Tashqi servis sizning IP'ingizni allowlist qilsa — NAT GW'ning Elastic IP'si beriladi.
- Ko'p ulanishda NAT port'lari tugashi mumkin (SNAT port exhaustion) — connection pooling.
- Docker ham NAT ishlatadi: `-p 8080:80` = DNAT, container'dan chiqish = MASQUERADE.

33350.a:
```sh
mtr -rwc 100 api.example.com            # hop'lar bo'yicha loss va latency
traceroute -T -p 443 api.example.com    # TCP bilan (ICMP bloklangan bo'lsa)

sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 host 10.0.2.10 and port 5432
sudo tcpdump -ni any 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-syn|tcp-rst) != 0'
sudo tcpdump -ni eth0 port 53 -w dns.pcap      # Wireshark'da ochish
```
O'qish:
- `SYN` ketdi, javob yo'q -> firewall/SG paketni tashlayapti (timeout).
- `SYN` -> `RST` -> port yopiq yoki servis ishlamayapti (connection refused).
- mtr'da o'rtadagi hop'da loss, lekin oxirida yo'q -> router ICMP'ni cheklagan, muammo emas.

33351.a:
Belgilar: `ping` ishlaydi, `curl` TLS handshake'da yoki katta javobda osiladi; SSH ulanadi, lekin `ls` katta katalogda qotadi.
```sh
ip link show eth0                       # mtu 1500 / 9001 (AWS jumbo)
ping -M do -s 1472 10.0.2.10            # 1472 + 28 = 1500, DF bilan
ping -M do -s 1400 10.0.2.10
tracepath 10.0.2.10                     # yo'l MTU
```
Yechimlar: tunnel interfeysida MTU'ni kamaytirish (masalan WireGuard 1420), TCP MSS clamping (`iptables ... --clamp-mss-to-pmtu`), ICMP type 3 code 4'ni bloklamaslik.
K8s CNI overlay'da pod MTU node MTU'dan kichik bo'lishi kerak.
